name: svatlas
description: Search AI startups and founders, find the companies most likely to buy a product, and keep outreach lists, from the sourced Silicon Valley Atlas directory.

interface.longDescription:
Silicon Valley Atlas maps the AI startup landscape: companies, founders, funding rounds, and investors from accelerator directories, company sites, and press. Every fact links to the public page it came from.

Ask in plain language to find startups by what they do, who they sell to, or the technology they use. Paste a product's website to get the companies most likely to buy it, ranked against an ideal-customer profile written from that site. Open any company for its stage, team size, funding with investors, founders, and sourced signals.

Keep the results as outreach lists: create, add, move, rename, merge, and clean them up from the conversation, then see sourced product announcements from the companies you track.

Sign in with the Google account you use on svatlas.io; lists you make in the conversation appear on the site.
capabilities: Search AI startups by meaning, sector, location, and accelerator program
Rank companies likely to buy a product from its website
Read sourced company profiles with funding, investors, and founders
Search founders by program, vertical, location, and founding year
Show sourced product announcements for companies on your lists
Find who in your own contacts can introduce you to a company, with a draft ask
Open Atlas from the ChatGPT sidebar and attach selected companies to a conversation
defaultPrompt: Find seed-stage AI startups building agents for legal teams
Which startups would buy the product at linear.app? Save the top 10 to a list
Summarize funding and founders for the companies on my Prospects list
